content:
@everyone

Sorry for the slow reply, I've been tied up with other work.

This change started with the Japanese text, not the performance. Our Japanese partners flagged that the first Japanese version of her lines fell short of the standard it needed to meet: consistency in how she refers to herself, natural phrasing, and accuracy of what the lines convey. After evaluating it, we contacted her VA and arranged a re-recording on short notice. There wasn't enough time, though, and it finished after the update had already shipped, so the second version went out afterwards as a bug fix. Because it was a separate session, the performance details don't fully match the first version, and that part is on us.

Ultimately this is a knock-on effect of our lead time internally still being too short. With Doresain we chose to delay; this time we wanted to avoid a delay, and rushing it created other problems instead.

Weighing everything, we won't be reverting this change. But we will take the lessons from this quality fix and make some adjustments to how we work: changing our Japanese translation vendor and review process, tightening supervision during voice recording, and continuing to pull our schedule earlier, so that when something unexpected happens we have more room to handle it and you run into fewer unnecessary changes.

Going forward, barring something we can't foresee or plan around — Murphy's original VA retiring, or a major situation of that kind — we won't change a character's voice on a whim, and we're improving the workflow for voice scripts and recording as well. Apologies again for the experience this voice bug fix caused.

content:
抱歉最近一直在忙别的事，没能及时解释。

这次调整的起因在日语文本，不在表演。第一版日语翻译经日本专业合作方提醒，在人称设定的相符性、措辞自然度、信息准确度上没有达到应有的水准，评估之后我们紧急联络声优重新录制。但由于周期不够，完成时间晚于版本更新，所以第二版是上线之后当作 BUGFIX 补上的；也因为是另开的一场录制，表演细节没能完全和第一版保持一致，这是我们没有做好的地方。

归根结底这是我们内部工作提前量仍然不够导致的衍生问题——杜勒赛因那一次我们选择了延期，
这次我们希望尽量避免延期，但是还是因为匆忙产生了一些其他的问题。

本次调整我们仍然综合考虑不会撤回，但我们会吸取这次质量修正的经验，并做出一些工作调整：更换日语翻译供应方与审核、改善语音录制时的监修把控力度，并且继续提前工作进度，以确保意外发生时有更足够的时间调整，减少大家感受到的不必要调整。

我们今后除非有例如墨菲的初版声优退役或者有重大事件等无法预料规划的因素之外，我们不会贸然调整角色的语音。而未来语音文本和录制工作流程也会改善来减少这样的问题再次发生。对这次语音BUGFIX给大家带来的体验问题再次致歉。

content:
None of us on the team reads Japanese at a professional translator's level, so we weren't able to catch the quality problems in that first version ourselves.
Since we started working with them, our Japanese partners have helped us correct a great many small issues in Morimens' voice work. Whenever we get the chance to fix something, we do.
因为团队中的成员日语并不是专业翻译级水准，所以最初一版翻译质量我们没能识别出来。
日本合作伙伴自开始合作以来已经帮我们修正了Morimens非常多的细节语音问题。当我们有机会修正的时候我们都在尽量修正。
